qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the pressure regulator to valve housing on the 4HP-22 EH/4 HP-24EH/A5S 310Z transmission?
What torque value should be used for the solenoid valve to valve housing connection on A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions?
What is the torque specification for the A5S 560Z guide plate/parking lock mechanism?
What size screw is used for the pulse sender on A5S 310Z/A5S 440Z transmissions and what is its torque value?
What is the torque specification for the cover for servo piston on shift unit for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions?
What torque value is specified for the A5S 300J transmission components with M5 screws?
Which transmission types have a torque specification of 6 Nm for their components?
qa_pairs.answer: A5S 560Z, A5S 300J, and A5S 560Z pulse sender components have 6 Nm torque specifications.

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the retaining plate for solenoid valves and pressure regulator on A5S 440Z shift unit?
What section of the manual does this torque specification table cover?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-12 Automatic Transmission, specifically 24 34 Shift Valves, Parking Lock.

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque value shown in this table and for which component?
qa_pairs.answer: 25 Nm for the cover for servo piston on shift unit (A4S 270R/A4S 310R with 5/16" screw).
